heading: Kalkaji election result: AAP's Atishi receives warm welcome from supporters at her residence
paragraphs:
Kalkaji election results 2025: Delhi Chief Minister and AAP candidate Atishi won the Kalkaji constituency against BJP candidate Ramesh Bidhuri by over 3,500 votes. Meanwhile, Congress candidate Alka Lamba also lost by a huge margin. In her first reaction after the results, Atishi thanked the people of Kalkaji and said that the party's war against BJP will continue.

The Kalkaji Assembly constituency was one of the most fiercely contested seats in the 2025 Delhi elections, with chief minister Atishi of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) facing a tough fight against Congress’s Alka Lamba and BJP’s Ramesh Bidhuri. The counting of votes for the Kalkaji seat, along with 69 others in the Delhi Assembly election, began at 8 am.

According to the Election Commission, voter turnout stood at 54.59 per cent, a decline from the 2020 elections.

The BJP has not won the Kalkaji seat since 1993 but is relying on Bidhuri’s strong electoral track record to change that trend. Bidhuri, a three-time MLA from Tughlakabad, secured victories in 2003, 2008, and 2013, even during phases when the BJP faced challenges in Delhi. He later represented South Delhi as an MP in both 2014 and 2019 but was not given a ticket for the 2024 Lok Sabha elections.

Key candidates (Kalkaji constituency)- Leading/Trailing

Atishi (AAP) - Won

Ramesh Bidhuri (BJP) - Lost

Alka Lamba (Congress) - Lost

Who has represented Kalkaji over the years?

• The Kalkaji Assembly constituency has seen varied political representation over the years. In 1993, Purnima Sethi of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won the seat.

• The Indian National Congress (INC) took control in 1998, with Subhash Chopra emerging victorious. In 2013, Harmeet Singh Kalka of the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) secured the seat.

• The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) then gained dominance, with Avtar Singh winning in 2015, followed by Atishi securing victory in 2020.

AAP fights to retain its stronghold in Kalkaji

• Atishi is contesting from Kalkaji for the second time and remains one of AAP’s most influential leaders. She won the seat in 2020 with nearly 56,000 votes, securing a margin of over 11,000. Her prominence within the party has grown, particularly after becoming AAP’s first woman minister.

• A victory in Kalkaji would mark AAP’s third consecutive win in the constituency, following Avtar Singh’s triumph in 2015.

• Pradeep Gupta of Axis My India, in his exit poll predictions, suggested that AAP has an advantage in Kalkaji.

Congress aims for a comeback

• After failing to win a single seat in Delhi since 2015, the Congress sees the Kalkaji contest as a crucial opportunity for revival.

• Alka Lamba, who represented the seat from 1998 to 2013, is looking to stage a political comeback.

• Lamba’s political career has been marked by shifts—she was with Congress from 1994 to 2014 before joining AAP and winning the Chandni Chowk seat in 2015. However, she returned to Congress in 2019 and has since faced two electoral defeats.

• A victory in Kalkaji would not only bring Congress back into the Delhi Assembly but also serve as a statement against AAP, the party Lamba left after public disagreements.

Prime Minister Narendra Modi will address BJP workers at the party headquarters in New Delhi on Saturday, party's Delhi president Virendraa Sachdeva said.
Kalkaji election results LIVE: Conceding his party's defeat in the Delhi assembly election, AAP supremo Arvind Kejriwal congratulated the BJP for its victory.

"In a video message, the AAP national convenor said, “We accept people's mandate with humility and I congratulate the BJP for its victory and also hope that it will fulfil the expectations of the people of Delhi.”
Delhi chief minister Atishi on Saturday thanked the voters of Kalkaji, while adding that the “war” against BJP will continue. READ MORE
Delhi chief minister and AAP's candidate Atishi on Saturday defeated BJP's Ramesh Bidhuri by over 35,00 votes.
Celebrations are taking place outside the BJP's Delhi office as the Election Commission trends hint towards the party's return to power in the national capital.
Firecrackers are being burst, BJP flags are being waved and party supporters are dancing in joy.

Delhi BJP president Virendra Sachdeva told ANI that all the big faces of Aam Aadmi Party, including Arvind Kejriwal, Manish Sisodia, and Atishi, are the "face of corruption", adding that they will lose the Delhi election.

"We welcome the trends but we will wait for the results. We believe that people have voted against corruption in an election which was centred around BJP's good governance versus AAP's bad governance," he said.
BJP Kalkaji candidate Ramesh Bidhuri is racing ahead of Delhi CM Atishi in the assembly constituency.
He attributed the lead to the people's desire for development, which he claimed has been lacking under AAP chief Arvind Kejriwal's leadership.
Bidhuri said he is not just focused on winning, but also on serving the public.

"This lead (from Kalkaji) is the blessing of people of Kalkaji. Kejriwal has done no work in Delhi in the last 10 years. I believe aapda is going and BJP will come to power...We are here to serve the public, not for any position like CM," Bidhuri was quoted by ANI.

Kalkaji election result LIVE: Speaking to the media outside her residence today, Atishi described the election as a battle between "good and evil" and "work and hooliganism (gundagardi)." She expressed confidence that the people of Kalkaji and Delhi would support the Aam Aadmi Party and Arvind Kejriwal, saying, "I have high hopes that the people of Kalkaji constituency and the entire state of Delhi will stand up with the party that has worked, will stand up with the Aam Aadmi Party and Arvind Kejriwal."
She further asserted, "Arvind Kejriwal will become the Chief Minister of Delhi for the fourth time with a huge majority."
However, Atishi continues to trail in her Kalkaji constituency against BJP candidate Ramesh Bidhuri.

Kalkaji election result LIVE: Delhi Chief Minister and AAP leader Atishi on Saturday expressed confidence in her party’s victory in the Delhi Assembly elections. She asserted that the people of Delhi, including those from her constituency Kalkaji, would back AAP and re-elect Arvind Kejriwal with a strong mandate, even as she trailed behind BJP’s Ramesh Bidhuri in her own constituency.

Kalkaji election results 2025 LIVE: Delhi Police on February 4 responded to allegations by AAP's Kalkaji candidate, Atishi, that Ramesh Bidhuri’s son, Manish Bidhuri, interfered in the constituency during the 'silence period.'
The official X handle of the South East Delhi Deputy Commissioner of Police stated that a case has been registered against Manish Bidhuri for violating the Model Code of Conduct.
Kalkaji election results 2025 LIVE: Congress candidate from the Kalkaji assembly seat, Alka Lamba, visited Kalka Ji temple to offer prayers ahead of the Delhi Assembly election results.
Lamba is contesting against AAP’s Atishi, the current Delhi Chief Minister, and BJP’s Ramesh Bidhuri.

According to Delhi Police officials, they acted on a tip-off about the individuals allegedly carrying cash. A Flying Squad Team (FST) arrived at the scene and apprehended the duo.
